title: Amazon Prime Passed Costco And Never Looked Back
source: Amazon Prime worldwide member figures from company disclosures and earnings calls (the 2013 figure is a widely cited analyst estimate; Amazon last confirmed a count in April 2021 and has not disclosed one since, so the 2023 figure is a commonly cited analyst estimate, e.g. Consumer Intelligence Research Partners). Costco Wholesale paid member households worldwide from Costco's SEC 10-K filings. Figures approximate, rounded to the nearest million.
